title: Navbar Snippet Generator
description: Generate a responsive navbar with mobile hamburger menu — live preview plus HTML, CSS and JS.
howto: Enter your brand name and links (one per line: "Home|/").
Pick colors, theme and sticky behavior.
Preview it live — resize to see the hamburger.
Copy the code or download the self-contained navbar.html.

faqs.q: What link format do I use?
faqs.a: One per line as Label|/path — e.g. "Pricing|/pricing". If you skip the | part, the link points to "#".

faqs.q: How does the mobile menu work?
faqs.a: Below 768px the links collapse behind a hamburger button; the included JS toggles it with aria-expanded.
Yes — the toggle is a real <button> with aria-label and aria-expanded, and the nav uses semantic markup.
Toggle the sticky option to add position: sticky so the bar stays on top while scrolling.
